excerpt.zh: 我们获得可靠情报，[marauder_country_1.GetName]的掠夺舰队将经过此恒星系。这将是一个埋伏他们的绝佳机会。
excerpt.en: We have good intelligence that the [marauder_country_1.GetName] raiding fleet will be passing through this system. It will be a great opportunity for an ambush.
